title: From page structure to query-page signals
purpose: Connect retained content to the scoring model.
takeaway: The scorer compares the query with multiple page views while retaining document-only context features.

bullets: Query similarity to title, H1, outline, page, URL path, and section chunks.
Ten semantic summaries plus 45 prompt-only or document-only context features.
Logistic regression with website-grouped cross-validation and frozen splits.

speaker_notes: Avoid describing embeddings as factual verification.
